posts.en:
dsh-devquest is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a4c7ac6f60ef65f3328c.html
